title: Teams / meeting background example
slide_intent: Carry identity into an everyday meeting without obscuring the person who is speaking.
strategic_value: A branded environment can make DB recognizable in routine video conversations.
demonstration: A Teams window shows a woman in front of an architectural background with the DB mark and sleeper accents; the page header adds a red sleeper strip below.
practical_value: Compare where identity cues can sit around a participant’s face.
